subject: Coffee machine service
body:
2026-09-09T10:15:00+02:00 — Amira Becker: Mira, my class has become an unusually good test group for the coffee fault. Black coffee fine, then a milk drink, then flashing buttons.
2026-09-09T10:15:58+02:00 — Mira Falk: That matches Elena's note. The service desk needs the pattern written down, not another distant photo of a red light.
2026-09-09T10:17:05+02:00 — Amira Becker: Wanda added both buttons to the yellow sheet. Did anyone tell the visitors the water itself is fine?
2026-09-09T10:18:23+02:00 — Mira Falk: Milan is changing the heading. Apparently DO NOT TRUST was a little too open to interpretation.
2026-09-09T10:19:46+02:00 — Amira Becker: I'll offer tea for now. Please tell me before someone makes the kettle our next shared mystery.
2026-09-09T10:20:50+02:00 — Mira Falk: The kettle is behaving. I'll put peppermint on the regular order and keep the service notes at reception.
